tldr: Taurus rising: steady, grounded, and oriented toward calm embodiment.
body: With Taurus rising, you meet life through steadiness, sensory awareness, and the need to build something that can actually hold. People may experience you as composed, reliable, and harder to move than you first appear.
approach: Moves deliberately, protects peace, and trusts what proves itself over time.
shadow: Resistance to change, overattachment to comfort, or mistaking stillness for safety when growth is asking for movement.
note: Authored from approved project Big Three and sign material.
